To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

an effective audit committee can limit and control management opportunistic actions, especially earnings manipulation, through external auditors, both in the form of big four auditors and auditors who are not members of the Big Four, but with the condition that the audit period is long enough.
the more effective the company's audit committee is, and the more independent the auditor is, the more likely it is that earnings manipulation will be reduced
the audit committee and external auditor characteristics are not effective in reducing the earnings manipulation that occurs in companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of external and internal parties in reducing the prevalence of earnings manipulation, which is a form of good corporate governance.
the role of the audit committee in controlling earnings manipulation.
the role of the auditor in mitigating earnings manipulation, and the audit committee is a mechanism for good corporate governance in the Indonesian capital markets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the effectiveness of the internal party, in the form of the audit committee, is not sufficient to reduce earnings management, and the effectiveness of the external party, in the forms of auditor independence, reputation, and specialization, is also not sufficient to reduce the earnings management.

the effectiveness of the internal party (audit committee) and the external party (auditors) in the form of the reputation of the auditor and the auditor's specialization will affect earnings management.
an effective audit committee will be more able to reduce earnings manipulation, and this effect will be strengthened by the use of one big four auditor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

audit committee effectiveness can reduce earnings manipulation, and the use of one or two big four auditors will strengthen the relationship between the audit committee and the manipulation of earnings.
audit committees are an essential part of corporate governance and can reduce the prevalence of manipulation of earnings.
audit committee effectiveness can reduce earnings management, and the longer the auditor tenure and the use of a reputable auditor can further reduce earnings manipulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
an effective audit committee is not enough to reduce earnings manipulation, but must be combined with the use of a reputable auditor.
the effectiveness of audit committees is an important mechanism in reducing the prevalence of earnings manipulation.
the effectiveness of the Audit Committee and Auditor Reputation are important in reducing the prevalence of Earnings Management.
